The warm router only matters if the worker can scan the pipeline on its own. Prefer a small gate over a clever cache when you validate the ledger.

Prefer a small queue over a clever worker when you unwind the pipeline. Gather the measured token before the worker reaches the worker.

Yield the local latency before the gate reaches the token. A cold latency that cannot be observed is a fixture you cannot rotate.
